entry_item.definition: [= naγadul] n. Game, play; stage play; amusement, entertamment; festival, celebration, especially the national sport festival in Mongolia.

example.definition: To make fun, play pranks or practical jokes.
[It] is no joke, [it] is not amusing.
To give a theatrical performance; to have a celebration
To poke fun at; play a joke; jeer at somebody.
The festival of the 11th of July (anniversary of the Mongolian revolution).

entry_item.definition: n. Play, game, joke, fun. Gambling. Toys, playthings.
